target_customer: Biotech, diagnostics and life sciences labs paying for lab data software
problem: Biotech labs struggle with fragmented data across instruments, notebooks and sample tracking systems, and legacy LIMS tools are rigid.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for no-code ELN, LIMS, integrations and analytics

founders.name: Guru Singh
founders.background_notes: YC page describes a biotech researcher by training who founded biotech communities and a trade association in India.

founders.name: Satya Singh
founders.role: Co-founder, Chief Product and Operating Officer
founders.background_notes: YC page describes an engineer turned product manager. The company about page describes the two founders as brothers (via search summary).

technical_complexity.rationale: Configurable no-code data platform with instrument integrations and lab compliance needs; standard engineering with hard integration parts.

defensibility.rationale: Lab data and workflows embedded in a platform are costly to migrate, but incumbents and Benchling are established.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents kept selling to larger labs; Scispot grew in smaller biotechs and raised an $8M Series A in 2026.

market_need_then: Biotech startups needed affordable lab data tools as lab software was dominated by costly legacy LIMS; exact spend data from 2021 not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses scispot.io; the company site also appears at scispot.com

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical but accessible; positions as modern and no-code versus legacy LIMS

branding.community_and_virality: The company publishes many comparison and alternatives blog posts as content marketing

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive science and spot compound name but no press on the brand itself found; growth appears content and product driven.

outcome_analysis: Scispot raised about $2M over five years, then an $8M Series A in mid 2026 led by Avenue Growth Partners, and serves over 125 labs. It grew slowly and capital efficiently in a niche dominated by Benchling and legacy LIMS vendors, with a biotech native founder and a product platform engineer.
notes: Competitor list empty: only 2025 and 2026 comparison pages from Scispot itself and review sites were found, nothing dated near the 2021 batch, and the company site fetch returned 503. Benchling and LabVantage are current rivals and are mentioned in outcome terms only. Earlier rounds (pre-seed in mid 2021 of 125K to 375K, a 1.2M seed Oct 2023) appear only on aggregators (Bouncewatch, VCBacked) and are unverified; total roughly $10M including the Series A per BetaKit, which is the cross-check for the Series A date and amount (also reported by Fasken and HLTH). BetaKit gives the round as closing about two weeks before 4 June 2026. The GeekWire 2024 profile could not be opened because the domain check was rate limited.
